title: Describing changes over time / Tsarin canje-canje a lokacin dawa da yaushe
bridge: A cikin Turanci, don aiki da canje-canje an yi amfani da fasaha da 'get', 'become' da 'turn' wanda a cikin Turanci na yanzu na fassarawa kamar 'ya zama', 'ya shirya' ko 'ya canza'. A gaba da haka, Turanci ba ya yi amfani da kalma 'is' ko 'are' tare da sifa don nuna canje-canje; har instead, an yi amfani da wadannan kalmomin da ake yi. Kuma, Turanci yana da fasaha mai ban sha'awa bayan 'present perfect' ('have changed') da 'past simple' ('changed'), wanda ba ya da wata alaka da 'pretérito perfecto compuesto' da 'pretérito indefinido' na Turanci. Yanzu, masu koyarwa na Turanci da Turanci na iya yin kalma 'estoy más cansado' da 'I am more tired' a matsayin 'I have gotten more tired'.
rule: Don nuna canje-canje a Turanci: 1) Yi amfani da 'get' + sifa (ko sifa mai yawa) don canje-canje da yawa ko na gaggawa: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Yi amfani da 'become' + sifa/suna don canje-canje masu tsawon lokaci ko na fasaha: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Yi amfani da 'turn' + jini ko sifa don nuna canje-canje masu bayyana: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Don canje-canje na jiki ko lafiya, za a iya yin amfani da 'grow' (gajiya) da 'fall' (fara) a cikin kalmomin da ba a canza ba: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) Da 'used to' za a yi magana game da matsayi na baya da yaushe ba su da wata alaka da yanzu: 'I used to live here'. 6) Da 'no longer' da 'still' za a yi magana game da matsayi na baya da yaushe ba su da wata alaka da yanzu: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) 'Present perfect' ya yi amfani da yaushe canje-canje na yanzu ne: 'The town has changed a lot'. Ba a yi amfani da 'is' ko 'are' + sifa kamar cikin Turanci: 'estoy cansado' ba ne 'I am tired' idan ka son nuna cewa ka zama mai lafiya, har 'I have gotten tired'.

concept_examples.translation: Yau, mutane suna canza saboda shekaru.

concept_examples.text: The city has changed a lot.
concept_examples.translation: Birnin wata ce ta canza sosai.

concept_examples.text: She became more confident after the course.
concept_examples.translation: Ta shirya mai da adadin gaskiya bayan kursa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt ˈæftər ðə kɔːrs/

concept_examples.text: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
concept_examples.translation: Ganye suna canza zuwa jini a zaman fashe.

common_error.wrong: I am more tired now than before.
common_error.correct: I have gotten more tired now.
common_error.correct_alt: I have become more tired now.
common_error.explanation: An yi kuskure saboda a Turanci an yi amfani da 'estoy más cansado' don nuna canje-canje na jiki. Amma a Turanci, 'I am tired' yana nuna matsayi na yanzu ne, ba canje-canje ba. Don nuna cewa akwai canje-canje, ya kamata ka yi amfani da 'present perfect' tare da 'get' ko 'become' (ko 'have gotten' / 'have become'). Za ka iya yi da 'I am more tired' kawai idan ka yi magana game da matsayi tare da wani lokaci, amma ba na nuna canje-canje ba. Kada ka yi fasaha da kalma da ba a dace ba.

levels.label: Using get + comparative
levels.translation: Yin amfani da 'get' + sifa mai yawa

examples.original: It is getting colder.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈkoʊldər/
examples.translation: Ana yi da sabon sanyi (ya zama sanyi sosai).
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'get' + sifa mai yawa don canje-canje da yawa. A Turanci, a matsayin 'está haciendo' amma a Turanci za a iya yi da 'is getting'.

examples.original: My English is getting better.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈbɛtər/
examples.translation: Ingilishi na na canza da kyau (ya shirya da kyau).
examples.note: A wannan 'get better' ya daidai da 'sauki' a Turanci. Kada ka yi 'ser mejor'.

examples.original: The days are getting longer.
examples.phonetic: /ðə deɪz ɑːr ˈɡetɪŋ ˈlɔːŋɡər/
examples.translation: Ranan suna canza da girma (ya zama girma).
examples.note: Ya tabbata 'long' da tsawon kalma ne, amma sifa mai yawa shine 'longer' da -er.

examples.original: He became famous after the video.
examples.phonetic: /hi bɪˈkeɪm ˈfeɪməs ˈæftər ðə ˈvɪdi.oʊ/
examples.translation: Ya shirya mai fama bayan video.
examples.note: Para cambios de estatus (famoso, rico) se prefiere 'become'. En español se dice 'hacerse'.

examples.original: The situation became complicated.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən bɪˈkeɪm ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Matsayi ya zama mai wahala.
examples.note: Aquí 'become complicated' equivale a 'volverse complicado'.

examples.original: She became a doctor in 2010.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm ə ˈdɑːktər ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈtɛn/
examples.translation: Ta shirya likita a shekara ta 2010.
examples.note: Con profesiones o roles, se usa 'become' + sustantivo sin artículo.

levels.label: Expressing changes with used to and no longer
levels.translation: Nuna canje-canje da 'used to' da 'no longer'

examples.original: I used to live in Madrid.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ juːst tʊ lɪv ɪn məˈdrɪd/
examples.translation: Na yi rayuwarsa a Madrid.
examples.note: Para describir hábitos o estados pasados que ya no son ciertos, se usa 'used to' + verbo base.

examples.original: I no longer eat meat.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈlɔːŋɡər iːt miːt/
examples.translation: Ba zan ci nama ba da yaushe.
examples.note: En español se usa 'ya no', en inglés 'no longer' es más formal que 'don't... anymore'.

examples.original: She didn't use to smoke, but now she does.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdɪdnt juːst tʊ smoʊk bʌt naʊ ʃi dʌz/
examples.translation: Ba ta yi amfani da shisha ba a baya, amma yanzu ya yi.
examples.note: En negativo se usa 'didn't use to' (sin -d final en 'use'). Cuidado con la pronunciación: /juːst/.

translations.ha: Tsarin canje-canje a lokacin dawa da yaushe

title: Speculating and making deductions / Tsammanawa da yin nishadi
bridge: A cikin Turanci muna yin tsammanawa da yin nishadi da 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' + infinitive. Keya ce 'must' yana nuna tsammanin da ya fi sauki (positive), 'can't' yana nuna tsammanin da ya fi sauki (negative), 'might', 'may' da 'could' suna nuna imani (less certain). Yi tsoro: kada ka yi 'must not' don nuna tsammanin negative saboda a Turanci 'must not' yana nuna tsaratawa.
rule: Don yin tsammanawa a yanzu a Turanci, muna yin amfani da waɗannan modals da suka dace da tsarin da aka gabata: 'must' (tsammanin da ya fi sauki), 'can't' (tsammanin da ya fi sauki saboda ba a ciki ba), 'might', 'may', 'could' (imani, da yawa ba da tsammanin). Don yin tsammanawa a baya, muna yin amfani da 'must have + participle', 'can't have + participle', 'might have + participle', etc. Tsarin ne: subject + modal + verb base (present) ko modal + have + participle (past). Tsaro: a cikin Turanci, ba a yi 'must not be' don nuna tsammanin negative ba, an yi 'can't be'.

concept_examples.text: He must be tired after the long trip.
concept_examples.translation: Yake da mutuwa ne bayan tafiya mai yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst biː ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə lɔːŋ trɪp/

concept_examples.text: She can't be serious about moving to another country.
concept_examples.translation: Ba zai yi da hankali ba ne cewa zai koma wata kasar.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt biː ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈmuːvɪŋ tuː əˈnʌðər ˈkʌntri/

concept_examples.text: They might have forgotten the meeting.
concept_examples.translation: Zai iya suna suna da wasanni.

concept_examples.text: It could rain later, so take an umbrella.
concept_examples.translation: Zai iya yi da ruwa, saboda haka ka zo da wasanni.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrelə/

common_error.wrong: He must not be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct: He can't be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct_alt: He must be out because the lights are off.
common_error.explanation: Muna yin wata kuskure saboda a cikin Turanci ba a yi 'must not' don nuna tsammanin negative ba, 'must not' yana nuna tsaratawa ('ba zai yi ba' = ba da izini). Saboda haka, don nuna tsammanin da ba a ciki ba, muna yin amfani da 'can't' (ko 'couldn't' don yin tsammanin da ya fi sauki). Saboda haka, 'must be out' yana da ma'ana mai daidai: tsammanin da ba a ciki ba.

examples.original: You're a journalist. You must meet a lot of people.
examples.phonetic: /jʊər ə ˈdʒɜːrnəlɪst. juː mʌst miːt ə lɒt əv ˈpiːpl/
examples.translation: Kai ne murya. Ya kamata ka sani mutane da yawa.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'must' da muna da tsammanin saboda akwai dalilai. A Turanci, 'debe de'.

examples.original: That can't be the right answer.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt kænt biː ðə raɪt ˈænsər/
examples.translation: Wannan ba zai zama amsar daidai ba ne.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'can't' don nuna cewa wani abu ba zai faru ba. A Turanci, 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: He must have a lot of money because he drives a Ferrari.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ə lɒt əv ˈmʌni bɪˈkɒz hiː draɪvz ə fəˈrɑːri/
examples.translation: Ya kamata ya da yawa saboda yana motar Ferrari.
examples.note: Sabon abu yana shafi da 'because' (saboda) da ya nuna dalilai na tsammanin.

levels.label: Possibility with might, may, and could
levels.translation: Imani da might, may da could

examples.original: She might be at the gym right now.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt biː æt ðə dʒɪm raɪt naʊ/
examples.translation: Zai iya yin wasanni yanzu.
examples.note: 'Might' yana nuna imani da yawa ba da tsammanin da 'must'. A Turanci, 'puede que'.

examples.original: They may arrive late because of the traffic.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ meɪ əˈraɪv leɪt bɪˈkɒz əv ðə ˈtræfɪk/
examples.translation: Zai iya zuwa da daɗi saboda wasanni.
examples.note: 'May' ya daidai da 'might', amma da yawa da yawa mai tsarin. Dole ne duka suyi.

examples.original: This could be the best restaurant in the city.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə best ˈrestərɒnt ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Wannan zai iya zama mataki na yanzu a wannan gari.
examples.note: 'Could' kuma yana nuna imani da yawa da yawa a cikin magana.

examples.original: He must have studied a lot for the exam.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ˈstʌdid ə lɒt fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Ya kamata ya koyo da yawa don shiga sabis.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'must have + participle' don nuna tsammanin game da baya. A Turanci, 'debe de haber'.

examples.original: She can't have seen us because she didn't wave.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt hæv siːn ʌs bɪˈkɒz ʃiː dɪdnt weɪv/
examples.translation: Ba zai iya gan mu ba saboda ba ya fada mana.
examples.note: 'Can't have + participle' yana nuna tsammanin negative a baya. A Turanci, 'no puede haber'.

examples.original: They might have missed the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv mɪst ðə bʌs/
examples.translation: Zai iya suwa da bas asibiti.
examples.note: 'Might have + participle' yana nuna imani a baya. A Turanci, 'puede que hayan'.

examples.original: The roads are wet. It must have rained.
examples.phonetic: /ðə roʊdz ɑːr wet. ɪt mʌst hæv reɪnd/
examples.translation: Hanya sun yi. Ya kamata ya yi da ruwa.
examples.note: Dalilai da aka gani (hanya masu yunwa) suna nuna zakka mai tsammanin game da baya.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Bayyana damuwa da yanayin yarda da yaushe
bridge: A cikin Turanci, kana amfani da past tense ko past perfect domin yin magana game da yanayin yarda da damuwa (misali, 'if I had time, I would go'). A Turanci, tsarin yana da wata iri mai ban sha'awa: past simple (ko past perfect) a cikin clausa 'if', da 'would' + verb a cikin clausa mai matsayi. Wata kuskure mai yawa ita ce da ake yin fasalin 'if I would have', amma a Turanci clausa 'if' ba zai iya da 'would' ba. Kuma, don yin magana game da yanayin da ba a cikin shekaru ba, kana amfani da past perfect ('had + participle') a matsayin condicional mai yaushe, ko past simple a matsayin condicional na yaushe.
rule: A Turanci B1, don bayyana yanayin yaushe ko yaushe na gaba (second conditional), kana amfani da 'if + past simple' (ko 'if + past continuous') a cikin clausa condicional, da 'would + base form' a cikin clausa mai matsayi. Misalai: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (Ina da damuwa da yaushe, zan tafi). Ka lura cewa 'were' yana amfani da dukan mutane tare da 'if I were' (har ma 'was' yana da amfani a Turanci mai fasaha). Don bayyana damuwa game da shekaru da gabata (third conditional), kana amfani da 'if + past perfect' (had + participle) da 'would have + participle' a cikin clausa mai matsayi: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (Ina da damuwa da yaushe, zan nasara). Kuna iya amfani da 'I wish' + past perfect don bayyana damuwa: 'I wish I had studied.' (Ina da damuwa da yaushe, zan koyi). Ka lura cewa clausa 'if' ba zai iya da 'would' ko 'will'. A yanayin yarda mai fasaha, 'were' yana da godiya: 'If he were here...'.

concept_examples.text: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
concept_examples.translation: Idan na da kudi mai yawa, zan sayi mota.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd mɔːr ˈmʌni aɪ wʊd baɪ ə kɑːr/

concept_examples.text: I wish I knew the answer.
concept_examples.translation: Ina da damuwa in na san amsa.

concept_examples.text: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ta koyi da yawa, ta kasance ta nasara a jarrabawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd ˈstʌdid ˈhɑːrdər ʃiː wʊd hæv pæst ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: I would travel more if I were younger.
concept_examples.translation: Zan tafi wajen yin safari idan na da shekara mai yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl mɔːr ɪf aɪ wɜːr ˈjʌŋɡər/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I'd go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Ana yin wannan kuskure saboda a Turanci muna yin magana da 'if I would have time' (conditional), amma a Turanci clausa 'if' ba zai iya da 'would' ba. Domin samun wata hanyar da ba a cikin shekaru ba, ka lura cewa 'if' yana da past simple (ko past perfect) a matsayin condicional na yaushe, ko past perfect a matsayin condicional na gabata, da 'would' kawai a cikin clausa mai matsayi.

examples.original: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl ðə wɜːrld/
examples.translation: Idan na samu loteri, zan tafi wajen yin safari duniya.
examples.note: Recuerda que 'won' es pasado simple, no significa 'ganó' aquí.

examples.original: If he were taller, he could play basketball.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr ˈtɔːlər hiː kʊd pleɪ ˈbæskɪtbɔːl/
examples.translation: Si fuera más alto, podría jugar baloncesto.
examples.note: Ka lura cewa 'won' past simple ne, ba 'ya samu' ba a nan.

examples.original: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː hæd ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɑːlərz/
examples.translation: Idan na da girma mai yawa, zan iya wasanni da kwallo.
examples.note: La pregunta invierte el orden de 'would' y el sujeto.

levels.label: Third conditional (past regret)
levels.translation: Conditional na uku (damuwa game da shekaru da gabata)

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Idan na san wannan, zan zo da baya.
examples.note: Usa pasado perfecto (had + participio) en 'if' y 'would have + participio' en la principal.

examples.original: She wouldn't have missed the train if she had left home on time.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ɪf ʃiː hæd left hoʊm ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: Ella no habría perdido el tren si hubiera salido de casa a tiempo.
examples.note: Ka amfani da past perfect (had + participle) a cikin 'if' da 'would have + participle' a cikin clausa mai matsayi.

examples.original: If we had booked in advance, we would have got a discount.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː hæd bʊkt ɪn ədˈvɑːns wiː wʊd hæv ɡɒt ə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
examples.translation: Ta ba ta rasa jirgin sama idan ta fita daga gida da yaushe.
examples.note: En inglés británico 'got' se usa como participio; en americano a veces 'gotten'.

examples.original: I wish I had studied more for the test.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr fər ðə test/
examples.translation: Ina da damuwa in na koyi da yawa don jarrabawa.
examples.note: Con 'wish' + pasado perfecto expresa arrepentimiento sobre el pasado.

examples.original: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd spiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈfluːəntli/
examples.translation: Ojalá pudiera hablar inglés con fluidez.
examples.note: Da 'wish' + past perfect yana bayyana damuwa game da shekaru da gabata.

examples.original: I wish it weren't raining today.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ ɪt wɜːrnt ˈreɪnɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ina da damuwa in na iya yin magana da Turanci da fasaha.
examples.note: Con 'wish' + pasado continuo expresa deseo sobre una situación actual.

translations.ha: Bayyana damuwa da yanayin yarda da yaushe
